why: RJ-X47, pending #5791: the grid's thumbnails survive a relaunch. Draws a four-photo shoot's grid (four decodes), relaunches on the same support folder and draws it again (the trap: a memory-only cache decodes all four again; the disk tier must serve every one), then resets beach's develop (exposure 1 to neutral), which must decode beach once and nothing else. The disk tier is built (ST-6, ST-7); it runs once LibraryHeadless keeps thumbnails on disk, a headless grid draw counts its decodes and the job runner has a relaunch block (#5791).
